name: Hellyas

attributes.attribute: Arthurian hero and minor figure in Arthurian legend
ancestor of the Round Table knight Lancelot

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Hellyas is an Arthurian hero. He is a minor figure in Arthurian legend. Hellyas was an ancestor of the Round Table knight Lancelot.
